purchaseRegion.body: Purchases are currently available only in Thailand while we set up shipping in your area. You can still browse the marketplace and build your collection — buying is coming soon to your country.

sellerInfo.title: How selling works
sellerInfo.subtitle: A quick rundown of fees and what happens after a sale.
sellerInfo.feeBody: We keep a 9% fee on the item price. There are no CardStreet fees for shipping.
sellerInfo.stripeBody: Card payments run through Stripe, which deducts its processing fee (1.6% plus tax) from your payout.
sellerInfo.buyerBody: At checkout the buyer pays your item price plus shipping. The full amount is sent to your connected Stripe account.
sellerInfo.shippingBody: After a sale you'll get a Flash Express label. Pack the card in a small padded mailer, then pay Flash for the shipment when they collect it — covered by the shipping the buyer already paid you. Oversized boxes cost more, and the extra is on you.
